tasks.description: The Idea: Right now, highly qualified leads submit the form and wait for a call. We could integrate Calendly or Acuity Scheduling directly into the SuccessSummary.jsx page, but only for the best leads. How it works: If the Decision Engine calculates a Lead Score above 25 (e.g., severe injuries + the other driver's fault + recent dates), the confirmation page bypasses the "We will call you" message and instead says "Your case qualifies for immediate review. Select a time below to speak with Rob." This strikes while the iron is hot.

tasks.description: The Idea: A significant portion of injury victims in Kentucky may prefer to communicate in Spanish. How it works: Implement an i18n (internationalization) framework to add a seamless English/Español toggle to the navigation bar. The entire form, the micro-affirmations, and even the Shieldy AI bot would dynamically translate, opening up a massive new demographic of ad traffic.

tasks.title: Intake App: The Twilio SMS Fallback
tasks.description: The Idea: We deferred this earlier, but text messages have a 98% open rate compared to email's ~20%. How it works: When a prospect submits the form, the Vercel API immediately fires a personalized text message: "Hi [Name], this is the Morrin Law Office. We received your case details regarding the [Car Accident] and our team is reviewing them now. We will call you from this number shortly." It establishes instant trust and ensures they actually answer the phone when your intake team calls.

tasks.title: Intake App: A/B Testing & Heatmapping (PostHog Integration)
tasks.description: The Idea: Stop guessing what works and start measuring. How it works: We drop in a lightweight analytics tool like PostHog. We could run A/B tests on the landing page (e.g., "Does 'Free Case Review' convert better than 'See What Your Case Is Worth'?"). More importantly, we could record anonymous session replays to see exactly which form step causes mobile users to abandon the page, allowing us to surgically fix friction points.

The Idea: Allow highly motivated clients to upload their police reports or photos of their car damage directly within the flow. How it works: We add an optional step right before the contact info utilizing an encrypted bucket (like Firebase Storage). To make it incredible, we could even hook those uploads into a vision-capable AI model that instantly scans the police report to extract the investigating officer's name and the citation number, passing it straight into Lead Docket.
